svg.title: Priority flood versus actual lake water

cc:Work.dc:title: Priority flood versus actual lake water
cc:Work.dc:description: The only escape from the interior passes the 5 m sill, so its filled heights are 5 m. An actual level of 2.5 m leaves a closed lake and dry slopes. Flood parents are geometric ordering information, not rendered uphill river channels.
